What OrgVia does, module by module.

A plain list of the workflows in the product. Modules are switched on per organization, so what you see depends on the setup agreed with your administrator.

01

People & organization

The foundation the other modules build on.

Shown in product screens

  • People directorySearch and filter employees by department, role and status.
  • Employee profilesPersonal and employment details, reporting manager, access level and activity.
  • DocumentsAttach documents such as offer letters to an employee, with download and delete controls.
  • Add or import employeesCreate employees in a form or import a CSV.
  • Org chartReporting lines drawn from employee records.
  • Organization settingsCompany profile, departments and office locations.
  • Lifecycle actionsEdit, deactivate and manage an employee through their time with the organization.

02

Attendance & leave

Time and absence handled in the same record.

  • Clock in and outA dashboard panel shows time worked today and the last action.
  • Attendance board and historyLive attendance, punch history and CSV export for authorized users.
  • Authorized overridesCorrections by people with the right permission.
  • Leave policies and balancesConfigure leave types; employees see their balances.
  • Requests and approvalsEmployees apply; approvers act on the request.
  • Leave calendar and summariesSee who is away and review totals.

03

Payroll workflows

Configuration and runs, with payslips for employees.

Note. Statutory payroll rules differ by country and organization. Ask us in a demo how payroll would be configured for yours.

  • Salary recordsMaintain salary details per employee.
  • Payroll configurationSet up how payroll is calculated for your organization.
  • Payroll runsCreate and manage runs from an overview.
  • PayslipsEmployees can view their own payslips.

04

Hiring & onboarding

From open role to first week.

  • Jobs and candidatesTrack openings and the candidates for each.
  • InterviewsSchedule and record interviews.
  • Candidate exportExport candidate data to CSV.
  • Onboarding recordsTasks, mentors and welcome messages for new joiners.

05

Performance

Keep the conversation connected to the person.

  • Goals and feedbackSet goals and record feedback.
  • Skills and development plansTrack skills and plan growth.
  • Cycles and reviewsRun review cycles and complete reviews.

06

Compliance & administration

Controls for the people who run the workspace.

  • Roles and accessEmployee, Manager, Recruiter, HR and Administrator roles, enforced by the backend.
  • CompliancePolicies, acknowledgements, training, issues, reminders and CSV reporting.
  • Support ticketsRaise and track support requests from inside the app.
  • Notifications and account settingsPer-user notifications, profile and security settings.
